outcome: Maternal serum levels of Corticotrophin-releasing hormone (CRH)
Maternal serum levels of Wolfram syndrome 1 (WFS1)
cohort: The study included 108 singleton pregnant women divided into control, late-onset ICP, and early-onset ICP groups.
finding: Maternal serum and placental levels of CRH, UCN, and WFS1 were significantly increased, but their transcriptional levels were impaired, in the early-onset ICP group compared to controls, suggesting a disrupted compensatory response.
cross-section timing: During pregnancy, categorized by early-onset and late-onset intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy.
